title: Integrate reviewed WP1 public project-text preparation into the writing method
body:
## Goal
Integrate the independently reviewed WP1 proposal into existing writing-method preparation. Expected gain: an explicit WP1 contract and separate project-text controls in benchmark/writing/, with new integration provenance and reproducible checks for the changed tree. This is preparation only, not a trial, product implementation or readiness approval. No session can run LabVIEW.
## Acceptance
- [ ] Validate the exact preserved review benchmark/project-text-writing-0109/review-0110.json against SHA256 2dc007939a4b0637716027ef6e5a874702c9be7288daf80c3f007c07f382cdaf and its provenance before using its scoped CLEAR recommendation. Report pin drift rather than refreshing historical evidence.
- [ ] Extend benchmark/writing/method.json and README.md with WP1 as narrow public-development text preparation, preserving W1-W8 and WC1/WM1/WM2/WB1. Use the proposal's exact original, unique XML locator, requested text 2 to 3 and single-byte allowance; distinguish root version declaration from native save-version authority. No project file is edited.
- [ ] Extend benchmark/writing/controls.json and verify_method.py with a distinct project-text preparation check and positive plus decisive rejecting controls grounded in the pinned original. Preserve synthetic controls and reject no-op, wrong locator/value/precondition, unrelated byte/file changes, serialization changes, version drift and unsupported native/overall passes. The verifier must run offline with only repository inputs and standard-library Python, remain read-only and accept no external candidate input. Keep existing synthetic task definitions and required control reasons intact. Explicitly extend the currently fixed four-task inventory and synthetic-only visibility boundary for a distinct public-development project-text stratum. WP1 must keep native save_version unavailable; the known root LVVersion is a separate declaration, never a substitute. Qualify W2 native locator eligibility for text-only preparation without waiving native/full-trial prerequisites. Assert the new fixed control inventory and exact rejection reasons so controls cannot silently disappear. Record actual output and verifier/input hashes; verify the new provenance and historical unchanged-file pins in the same command without circular self-hashes. Do not execute the frozen proposal checker against changed inputs; if needed run it only at its historical pinned tree and clearly label the result historical.
- [ ] Regenerate benchmark/writing/verification.json only from actual integration checks. Add benchmark/writing/integration-0112-provenance.json and integration-0112-provenance.md for baseline identity, input/output hashes, mapping, historical-checker invalidation and unchanged historical evidence. New pins must not pretend to be independent review of this changed tree.
- [ ] Leave input-pins.json, review-corrections.json, proposal/checker/review evidence, originals/licenses and preparation.json unchanged. Do not refresh the frozen #544 checker to accept changed writing inputs. Only the five named writing-method files and two new integration provenance files may change in the repository.
- [ ] Keep independent key approval, full native keys/validation, matched allocations/budgets/quota, actual isolation and explicit owner method acceptance pending. Public Actor Framework derivatives remain one familiar-possible development lineage. No candidate arms, owner request, evaluator change, readiness promotion or product work. Preserve C1: structured controls do not verify arbitrary narrative or future answers; semantic/extra-claim/contradiction/citation review remains required.
## Verification
python3 -I benchmark/writing/verify_method.py
## Context
- benchmark/project-text-writing-0109.md: reviewed proposal specifies exact integration paths and preservation/trial boundaries.
- benchmark/project-text-writing-0109/review-0110-provenance.md: #551 records exact review preservation, scoped CLEAR and new-addendum/separate-review requirements.
- docs/perpetua/evaluation.md and roles.md: preparation, independent review and owner acceptance precede product work.
## Budget
Read benchmark/project-text-writing-0109.md and .json; selectively extract identities, scoped files, findings and later integration assessment from benchmark/project-text-writing-0109/review-0110.json, not the whole large artifact. Read review-0110-provenance.md; benchmark/writing/{method.json,README.md,verify_method.py,controls.json,verification.json,input-pins.json,review-corrections.json}; docs/perpetua/{roles.md,evaluation.md}; and proposal-named original/license and baseline/runner-contract.md and precision/README.md only for cited obligations. Use short scoped outputs, no whole-repository discovery. Save bounded integration by halfway through 80 turns. Do not repeat #547/#541/#493 review probes, POC/source discovery or project selection. Parent commits; engine verification has no session artifacts or LABVIEW_ENVIRONMENT. Report final baseline/candidate identities and exact changed paths for the next cold independent reviewer. Separate review of the changed integration tree follows in a later iteration.
